summary: Review C round 2 passes Phase 1 of primary_class_session_lifetime_20261111 at 2d05e9e9bc74c1fbc1d52b59f5ca54aa42b494a9. The repository HEAD is b9f5439d4 (a Storytime test commit, out of scope); no file under apps/primary-advantage or packages changed after 2d05e9e9b. Green rem1 fixed F141, F143, and F144 as I advised: after 17:00 one radio is checked and the start posts '3h', the alert clears on a new choice, the manual text is changed in five files, and the group has a visible label with aria-labelledby and an aria-describedby for the 7-day help. I withdraw F141, F143, and F144. The API wiring did not change (api.ts, handlers.ts, http.ts, and the route are untouched since round 1). I found no blocking finding, no major finding, and one new nit (F181) for the close-out record. F142, F145, and F146 stay with the user as ESCALATE items. I did not run the tests; the shell refused the vitest call again, and Review A and Review B report their own runs at this HEAD.
nonblocking_findings: F181 (nit, for the close-out record): class-session-control.tsx uses the fixed ids 'class-session-lifetime-label' and 'class-session-lifetime-help' and the fixed radio name 'class-session-lifetime'. Only one ClassSessionControl renders on a page today (class-login-panel.tsx:74 inside one ClassLoginPanel in enhanced-class-roster.tsx:300), so the ids are unique. A second instance on one page would give duplicate ids and one shared radio group. Advice: use useId if a second instance is ever added. Not a defect now.
evidence: F141 withdrawn: I read class-session-control.tsx at 2d05e9e9b. choices is computed before run() (before1700 from minutesOfDay with SCHOOL_TIME_ZONE), effectiveLifetime = choices.includes(lifetime) ? lifetime : '3h', the radios use checked={effectiveLifetime === choice}, and run('start') posts lifetime: effectiveLifetime. After 17:00 'until_17' is not in choices, so '3 hours' is the one checked radio and the start posts '3h'. The radio onChange calls setLifetime(choice) and setError(null), so the alert clears on a new choice. The poll (10 s) re-renders the control, so the fallback shows within 10 s. A hidden choice never reaches the server. Tests: 'falls back to 3 hours when the clock passes 17:00 with until_17 selected' (rerender across 17:00, '3 hours' checked, body lifetime '3h'), 'clears the lifetime error when the teacher picks another option', and 'posts until_17 before 17:00 Bangkok' (this one also closes Review A F125).

F143 withdrawn: grep 'after 3 hours|หลัง 3 ชั่วโมง' over apps/primary-advantage finds no match now. The git diff 9e2bc7492..2d05e9e9b shows step4 changed in en.json, th.json, cn.json, tw.json (all line 4380), and vi.json (line 4229). en: 'The class also closes by itself at the time you chose: 3 hours, until 17:00 today, or 7 days.' The other four locales: cn, tw, and vi hold the same English text (decision F5); th: 'ชั้นเรียนปิดเองตามเวลาที่คุณเลือก: 3 ชั่วโมง ถึง 17:00 ของวันนี้ หรือ 7 วัน'. The list in the sentence matches the three option labels in en and th. The five files parse as JSON (python json.load, 5 of 5 ok). The new th sentence must join the plan task 1.10 hand-off for Daniel's Thai check; the th text uses 'คุณ', which Daniel should check.

F144 withdrawn: the label is now a visible paragraph

with the lifetimeLabel text. The radiogroup has aria-labelledby='class-session-lifetime-label'. It has aria-describedby='class-session-lifetime-help' only while the effective choice is '7d', and the help paragraph carries that id. Test 'names the group with a visible label and describes the 7 day help' checks getByText(label), the radiogroup name, aria-labelledby, no aria-describedby by default, and the describedby target text after the click on '7 days'. The keys and the text of the label did not change.

Check 5, API wiring, no regression: git diff --stat 9e2bc7492 2d05e9e9b over api.ts, apps/primary-advantage/lib, and packages/db is empty. The only edits in packages/domain/src are the JSDoc of classSessionLifetime (contracts.ts, F122) and the line split in class-session.ts:169-170 (F123); neither changes behavior. The chain is the same as in round 1: class-session-control.tsx posts { classroomId, lifetime } to class-session/start; route.ts exports POST = startClass; handlers.ts parses with classSessionStartInput; expiresAt reaches the text; invalid_input maps to lifetimeInvalid in api.ts:89 and shows in role=alert. The post body now uses effectiveLifetime, which is always one of the three enum values, so a refusal from the contract cannot come from the panel.

Check 4, browser scope for the UX role (task 1.12), changed by rem1 in four points. Unchanged: scratch database copy (never the shared primary_advantage), free port (not 3005, not 3099), next build and next start under heavy-run.sh, one viewport 1366x768, th and en, heavy lock priority after Storytime. Changed: (a) item 9 becomes: the group label is a visible line above the radios; record its text, its font weight, its color contrast, and that it is not confused with the startHelp or openNoCode line; read the accessibility tree and confirm the radiogroup name equals the label. (b) F141 check: select 'until_17' at 16:59 Bangkok (page.clock), let the clock pass 17:00 plus the 10 s poll, then record that exactly one radio is checked ('3 hours'), that Start posts lifetime '3h', and that an old lifetime alert clears when a radio is clicked. (c) the help text: when '7 days' is selected the accessibility tree shows the help text as the description of the radiogroup; with another choice there is no description. (d) the manual page (the teacher manual section startClass, step4) shows the new sentence in th and en; one look at the page is enough. Still required: option_min_height_px (44 or more) and label width, radio_input_px, arrow keys and focus ring, '3 hours' checked at the first render, 7-day start body keys (classroomId, lifetime), the expiry text with the date against the response in Bangkok time (en 12-hour, th 24-hour), the class_start audit row lifetime=7d, F142 (reload after a 7-day start, read the checked radio and the text above it, press New code, record the new expiry), the refusal text by route intercept (400, code invalid_input) in th and en, end the class and the class code fails at the student sign-in page, console errors and hydration warnings, text contrast of the help text and the disabled state while busy. The real hide of 'until_17' can run without a clock override at any time after 17:00 Bangkok. Optional second viewport 390x844. Screenshots under /tmp/opencode. Evidence class: automated or person-checked, as the note says. Cleanup: stop the server by the pid from ss -ltnp for its port, remove the scratch database and the build output.

ESCALATE items carried, unchanged, no new evidence: F142 (the choice is not stored; after a reload the group shows '3 hours' while a 7-day session is open, and New code then makes a 3-hour session; the manual newCode sentence still says only 'The app shows a new code, and the old code stops working'), F145 (lifetimeHelp7d says 'until this time' with no time before a start, names cards only, 'End the class' against the button 'End class', 17:00 against 5:00 PM in en), F146 (English stopgap text in cn, tw, and vi without a lang mark). F101 and F124 were not mine to re-judge beyond round 1. The rem1 change did not touch these texts, so my round 1 judgment stands. F122, F123, and F125 are fixed (contracts.ts JSDoc, class-session.ts line split, the 'posts until_17' test).
